text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, come along too, Glacé-san! To 
Taiki-san's party!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah!! I want to socialize even more! 
Gathered around delicious food!"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sounds fun...! The food is bound to 
be delicious too—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"What!? Why did it turn out like THAT, 
please!?"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Holding back on playing around and 
channeling all that pent-up frustration 
into your training! Isn't that the perfect 
chance to get stronger?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You mean it's the perfect day for 
training!? That sounds so fun~!! I'm gonna 
run too! Lemme run~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you don't want smooth carrot 
cake and a new party game?!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what an enticing sound! Nngh~~~! It's 
so worth holding out for!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Slope dashes over video games! Burpees 
over cake!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Taiki! Come on, tempt me more! It'll only 
make me that much stronger!
